findings.message: Acceptance criteria 3 and 4 require rejecting missing-input failures while accepting defect failures from arbitrary argv commands. ProcessExec supplies only exit status and captured streams, which can be identical for both cases. The governing unit defines no defect-result protocol, and section 7 prohibits per-runner output parsing, so implementing this distinction requires inventing missing contract facts.
